summary: Verified all new Rich Text Editor features: Font Selector with 10 fonts, Color Picker with 20 preset colors + custom hex input, and Transparent Background. All features working correctly.
passed_tests: ✅ Font selector popover opens correctly from Type icon button
✅ Each font is displayed in its own style (font-family applied inline)
✅ Fonts: Arial, Helvetica, Verdana, Tahoma, Trebuchet MS, Georgia, Times New Roman, Courier New, Impact, Comic Sans MS
✅ Clicking a font applies it to selected text (verified: <font face='Georgia, serif'>)
✅ Color picker popover opens correctly from Palette icon button
✅ Color picker shows 20 preset colors in 5x4 grid
✅ Hex text input with placeholder '#FFFFFF' present
✅ Apply (Aplicar) button for custom colors present
✅ Clicking preset color applies it to text (verified: <font color='#ff0000'>)
✅ Color indicator next to Palette icon updates to show current color
✅ Custom hex input works - color indicator updated to rgb(255, 153, 0) after entering #FF9900

features: 10 fonts with name and CSS value

context_for_next_testing_agent: RTF Editor new features verified: (1) Font Selector with 10 fonts - each displayed in its own style, applies correctly via document.execCommand('fontName'). (2) Color Picker with 20 preset colors + custom hex input - colors apply via document.execCommand('foreColor'), color indicator updates in real-time. (3) Transparent background implemented via CSS rules targeting .rich-text-editor and .rich-text-editor * with background-color: transparent !important. RTF Editor opens via Sparkles button (data-testid='add-rich-text-btn') which opens a Dialog.
